title: Scan Result Response

operatorSteps.title: Review scan result assessment
operatorSteps.instruction: Review scan result findings, evidence refs, target scope, and policy/plan provenance before recommending controls.

operatorSteps.title: Plan exposure controls
operatorSteps.instruction: Draft a non-executing control plan for endpoint exposure, TLS posture, service banners, unexpected services, and incomplete scan coverage.

operatorSteps.title: Record scan reassessment command
operatorSteps.instruction: Record the reassessment command that should be run after approved controls are applied and a new scan result artifact is available.

recommendedControls: Verify target scope before any scan-derived remediation planning.
Require TLS for exposed web endpoints and review certificate metadata.
Review HTTP exposure and require approved ingress, headers, and transport policy.
Reduce service banner disclosure where operationally feasible.
Close or justify unexpected services against approved policy scope.
Rerun assessment only under policy authorization after control changes.
nonClaims: This playbook does not execute scans.
This playbook does not contact targets.
This playbook does not perform exploitation.
This playbook does not authorize remediation.
